method: Actual continuous full raw payload reads precede this reviewer-authored semantic acceptance. Inventory generation does not create facts or upgrade read status. All record values, structures, descriptions and missing/default cases considered; complete reader IO retained.

record_policy_facts.fact: Every record in each supplied raw file was actually read including descriptions, ordinary/important flags, context enums, every price and Move identity; no record omitted because no default caller. Binding is Item schema/constructor methods plus compile_items/whole compiler and writer. Omitted use0/price0/sellhalf/BP1/consumable inverse-important are constructor defaults, not copied numeric assumptions from an alternative backup. Text display names/plurals/description do not choose effect handler by name; registered ID does.

FieldUse and BattleUse are exact context selectors, handler lookup/conditional identity and aliases are separate. Every present active identity was compared to full Item_Effects1524 and Item_BattleEffects712; aliases with definitions but absent raw records remain callable-definition/conditional-registration facts, not invented default inventory. Generation backups differ in availability, pricing, flags and machine content, so all receive separate conditional semantics. TM/HM important nonconsumption versus TR normal consumable and TM57 default TR ChargeBeam are retained.
record_policy_facts.acceptance: ALL_PRESENT_RECORDS_ITEM_ENTRY_EFFECT_DEFINITIONS_RECEIVED; species/move records and battle caller facets separately named

record_policy_facts.fact: Each present Price/SellPrice/BPPrice received as its own exact input to adapter. Current default alternative SellPrice overrides and missing backup SellPrice half default differ; no blanket 50percent sale rule. Explicit free use, important flags, key/non-key classification, balls bonus qualification, and descriptions independently considered. Source constructor/schema nonnegative grammar has no walletMAX clamp; editor limit is not PBS limit.

Every record full flag list was read. Exact flags are case-insensitive full comparisons for Berry/Mail/IconMail/PokeBall/SnagBall/KeyItem/EvolutionStone/Fossil/Apricorn/TypeGem/Mulch/MegaStone/Scent; arbitrary Fling_/NaturalGift_ prefixes are distinct from full flags. MegaStone excludes Red/Blue Orb. Registered held-item effects can use identity without dedicated item flags, so record read is not passive effect proof. Gen6/7 MegaRing KeyItem-only and current default KeyItem,MegaRing remain conditional data facts, not automatic discrepancy.
record_policy_facts.acceptance: DATA_FLAG_SEMANTICS_RECEIVED; non-item system consumers named in interfaces

record_policy_facts.fact: Accept actual com_move R011 and child R008 facts only after complete receipt artifact reads: NaturalGift needs current Berry plus any prefix, no Unnerve admission check; first complete type+digits determines registered type or Normal; per-hit current held ID chooses complete power >=10, no full match1, nil fails identity access. Fling valid active losable item, berry-consumption gate, any prefix; first complete numeric power min10 else10; substitute/ShieldDust and named target effects separate, later consumes current held identity when callback reached. Per-generation raw NaturalGift powers60/70/80 in Gen5 versus later80/90/100 are data inputs; no unproved type-difference claim.

All four Shadow backup records fully read. They have OnPokemon but no Scent flag in this supplied backup, so Hyper entry does not bypass the ordinary gate simply because names contain scent. Shadow item handlers/heart-gauge/purify aliases full read; no automatic copying of backup into default runtime. Existing WP23 gate and timeflute heart>0 early purification behavior preserved.

Default693, Gen5 526, Gen6 601, Gen7 637, Gen8 693, Shadow4 records are per-path denominators, total3154 path-record instances. Gen8 default identical blob/SHA/bytes independently proven; Gen8 path associated with full default semantic review, not separate own display. Backup files are conditional if copied/compiled via loader and not assumed concurrently registered. No historical PASS used.

All record IDs/held-identity fields may be consumed by facility item setter and identity clauses; finite Pokemon setter/getter/hasItem facts in facility-item-interface.json. Actual facility84 raw/83 normalized item identity arrays and complete PBF-ITEM contract received from pbs_creature_facility. DefaultSTICK missing becomesnil; LEEKdistinct; ItemClause ignoresnone thencomparesrawitem_id, notcan_hold/effect/price. Source/template full reading remains credited actual facility reviewer; record inventory is not a substitute.

per_record_binding: pbs-record-inventory.json enumerates each actually-read record and exact field vector; apply PBS-FIELDS/PRICE/FLAGS to every row, PBS-ACTIVE to the exact use selectors and ID handlers, finite combat fields PBS-FLING-NG, Shadow exact records PBS-SHADOW. This is not a generated line-as-fact acceptance.
scope: All6 initial data paths considered. Passive battle/AI, species/move registries, loot/berry planting/crafting and external consumers remain named interface responsibilities where not actually received. No all-domain PASS.
